scenarios.name: Compound Transaction Lifecycle Failure
scenarios.fault_injected: Mid-lifecycle failure after graph and feature mutation, before case creation response
scenarios.recovery_performed: Client retries idempotent transaction ingestion; system replays without double counting

scenarios.name: Cross-Tenant Adversarial Composition
scenarios.fault_injected: Deliberately colliding transaction ID, customer ID, and idempotency key across Bank Alpha and Bank Beta
scenarios.independent_oracle: Tuple (tenant_id, object_type, canonical_object_id) strictly segregated; Tenant B cannot access or mutate Tenant A data
scenarios.recovery_performed: Cross-tenant access attempted under retry/cache hit; server returns 403 Forbidden or isolated Tenant B state

scenarios.name: Model-Version / Decision-Provenance Race
scenarios.fault_injected: Model Version 2 promoted to champion while Transaction T is in-flight under Version 1
scenarios.independent_oracle: Transaction T provenance remains strictly Version 1; Transaction U bound to Version 2; historical query reports V1
scenarios.recovery_performed: Downstream asynchronous evaluation completes; records verified against respective model versions

scenarios.name: Corrupted or Replayed State Boundary
scenarios.fault_injected: A: Identity conflict with altered payload; B: Non-finite numeric state (NaN/Inf); C: Stale case version replay
scenarios.independent_oracle: All three corruption classes rejected/quarantined with 409 Conflict, 422 Unprocessable, or InvalidCaseTransitionError
scenarios.recovery_performed: Client refetches authoritative state or submits valid finite payload; state remains uncorrupted

scenarios.name: Full Lifecycle Recovery & Semantic Reconciliation
domains_crossed: End-to-End: Ingestion -> ML Decision -> Alert -> Case -> Four-Eyes -> Resolution -> Audit
scenarios.fault_injected: Worker service interruption after case creation; recovered worker completes investigation
scenarios.independent_oracle: 7-dimension semantic reconciliation: Transaction, Machine, Alert, Case, Regulatory, Audit, and API truth coherent
scenarios.recovery_performed: Fresh service instance recovers case dossier, collects distinct supervisor signatures, and resolves case

metamorphic_checks.name: Clean vs Recovered Lifecycle
metamorphic_checks.criterion: LogicalState(clean) == LogicalState(recovered) for durable business objects

metamorphic_checks.name: Tenant Renaming
metamorphic_checks.criterion: Identical workflow under alternative tenant namespace produces strictly partitioned namespace with identical financial semantics

metamorphic_checks.name: Model Activation Timing
metamorphic_checks.criterion: Transaction T provenance is identical whether Model V2 is activated during or after T's downstream async work
